lines: Chase's workload jumped lately: 14.0 targets a game over his last 3, up from 9.7 on the season, with a 37% target share.
He averaged 32.2 PPR points and 175.7 receiving yards over the last 3 games, and played 90% of snaps.
Week 11 is at WAS, who allow the 13th-most PPR points per game to WRs; the coach said Chase stays the primary downfield target.
